Our article **"Decarbonizing the cement industry in Latin America and the Caribbean"** — co-authored with A. González-Quiroga and O. Pupo-Roncallo — was published in the August 2026 issue of **International Cement Review**, the leading global trade publication for the cement industry.

The piece reviews near-term decarbonization measures and the enabling conditions needed to make next-generation projects bankable across the region, covering alternative fuels, plant modernization, electrification, and CO₂ infrastructure. A sample of the issue is available [online](https://assets.cemnet.com/sample/magazine/icr-aug-2026-sample/index.html){target="_blank"}.
